contract.canonicalPurpose: App Health helps product teams understand web traffic, intentional user actions, and application health across their projects.
contract.audience: Product managers, founders, and product teams; developers connect the instrumentation.
contract.job: Read live sessions, 24-hour traffic and owner-approved top routes and sources in a stable report that embeds on a product.
contract.thesis: A calm editorial product story opens into a precise analytics workspace, using dark graphite surfaces and quiet indigo data marks.
contract.system: System sans typography with restrained weights, semantic graphite surfaces, indigo actions and data, emerald live state, fine grid lines, and compact evidence labels. Light mode uses warm neutral surfaces with the same semantic hierarchy.
contract.signature: A shared traffic-and-event pulse chart links the illustrative landing proof to the authenticated report.
contract.risk: Anonymous sharing is an intentional disclosure; dedicated read credentials and visible scope keep private telemetry outside the public surface.
